editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: Eightcap is a legitimate Tier-1 regulated broker scoring 7.6/10 from NAFT in 2026. ASIC, FCA, and CySEC licences provide genuine oversight for a platform that has carved out a dominant position in regulated crypto CFDs — 250+ coins available, more than any competitor at this regulatory tier. Native TradingView integration, Raw spreads from 0.0 pips at $7 RT, zero inactivity fees, and free withdrawals create a complete package. The 800 total instruments trail multi-asset leaders, and the 75% retail loss rate is on the higher end. But for the crypto-focused trader who demands both leverage and regulation — or the TradingView user who wants to trade directly from charts with raw ECN pricing — Eightcap is the strongest option available in 2026.
